0.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_001
0.description: I am the official charged with the bestowal of sanction upon our members. As you are not one of us, I am afraid you cannot avail yourself of these services.

1.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_006
1.description: I am the official charged with the bestowal of sanction status upon those of the rank of <hex:020947E802FF1563686965662073746F726D207365726765616E74FF1763686965662073657270656E74207365726765616E74FF15636869656620666C616D65207365726765616E7403> or above. How might I serve you this day?

2.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_Q00
2.description: What would you like to do?

6.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_011
6.description: Heed me, O Sagacious Builder! Grant Thee Thy divine favor unto this Thy faithful servant!

7.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_012
7.description: It is done─the sanction of our organization is now bestowed upon you. I pray for your every success in the field.

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_016
8.description: In a bid to outfit our men and women in superior equipment, the foremost minds of <hex:020944E802FF0E746865204D61656C7374726F6DFF1C746865204F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF1474686520496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D657303> and the Eorzean Alliance have come together to develop an advanced method of gear enhancement.

9.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_017
9.description: The result is “sanction,” a process which involves the casting of any one of a range of enhancing spells on gear specially crafted to harbor enchantments.

10.name: TEXT_COMDEFSANCTION_00086_FLAMEMAGE_018
10.description: The <hex:020945E802FF0E4D61656C7374726F6D20686173FF1C4F72646572206F6620746865205477696E20416464657220686173FF15496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573206861766503> recently devoted additional resources to the manufacturing of such arms and armor. Sanction-ready items are available to those of the rank of <hex:020947E802FF1563686965662073746F726D207365726765616E74FF1763686965662073657270656E74207365726765616E74FF15636869656620666C616D65207365726765616E7403> or above in exchange for company seals.
